findings.title: Replacement would alter LaTeX command or equation source
findings.evidence: methods/methods-eq1 is a LaTeX block with 2 match(es).
findings.action: Preview equation output and require formula-owner approval before applying source-mode replacements.

findings.title: Replacement would mutate notebook or code cell source
findings.evidence: methods/methods-code1 is notebook source with 1 match(es).
findings.action: Create a code-review task and rerun the notebook before sharing updated outputs.

findings.title: Replacement would alter citation keys or reference anchors
findings.action: Route citation-key changes through the reference manager merge workflow instead of direct replacement.

findings.title: Batch replacement touches a locked or final-review section
findings.evidence: final-figures/fig1-caption has 2 match(es) while section state is locked.
findings.action: Exclude the section, unlock with an audit reason, or convert matches to explicit suggestions.

findings.title: Replacement touches cross-reference anchors
findings.evidence: final-figures/fig1-caption contains figure, table, or equation anchors.
findings.action: Regenerate cross-reference maps and hold export until anchors resolve.

findings.title: Replacement would invalidate an inline comment quote anchor
findings.evidence: Comment cmt-17 anchors to text that would be replaced in block methods-p1.
findings.action: Convert the edit to a suggestion and re-anchor or resolve the comment before applying.

findings.title: WYSIWYG replacement crosses source-only content
findings.evidence: The operation starts in WYSIWYG mode but reaches LaTeX, citation, or code source blocks.
findings.action: Split the operation by block type so source-mode changes receive explicit review.
